evidence: simulation/forecast_schedule.py is a deliberately minimal controller: ceil(demand/rho) + rolling-max hysteresis + trailing-lead cold-start (lines 11-17, 130-150), no PID/optimizer. The reactive baseline shares that exact controller ('identical capacity rule, hysteresis and cold-start... the only difference vs forecast is signal lead time', lines 61-65). Because the control law is held fixed and only the information source (archived TSFM forecast vs observed trailing bin) varies, any performance gap is attributable to information, not control sophistication -- exactly the design rationale claimed.
